canada.title: Minister hints at soaring new cost for Civic hospital replacement
canada.summary: Ontario's minister of infrastructure says the province is now investing nearly $10 billion in The Ottawa Hospital's new Civic campus, raising further questions about the delayed project's total cost — and what the Ottawa community will be asked to contribute.

canada.title: Dead humpback whale that was struck by ferry towed to First Nation for ceremony
canada.summary: The Squamish Nation will honour the whale's life and spirit through a ceremony and traditional practices.

canada.title: Suspected cougar attack left two horses injured outside Raymore, Sask.
canada.summary: The horses were found injured on a ranch north of Raymore on Oct. 24, after what an owner and veterinarian suspect to be a cougar attack.

canada.title: Why did fall leaves hang on longer this year in Sask.?
canada.summary: Most of the tree leaves in Saskatchewan have fallen after gusting winds and wintry weather rolled through the province over the past week. But this autumn, the red, orange and yellow canopy held on longer than in other years.

canada.title: MLAs call on N.W.T. gov't to offer more support for residents facing high fuel costs
canada.summary: With winter approaching, some N.W.T. MLAs are asking the territorial government to offer more financial support and incentives for residents dealing with the high cost of home heating fuel.

canada.title: 2 years on, the Nunavut government is still trying to get elder mobility vans on the road
canada.summary: Some community leaders in Nunavut are frustrated that elder mobility vans promised to several communities two years ago are still parked. The premier says his government is working to fix that.

canada.title: Here’s why EverWind’s plans to use diesel generators at the Point Tupper data centre don’t require an environmental assessment
canada.summary: EverWind chose 42 MW generators, falling below the regulatory threshold of44 MW.

canada.title: New Deer Lake clinic sits empty, with opening date unknown, amid road connection dispute
canada.summary: A brand new 30,000-square-foot community health clinic in Deer Lake is stuck in limbo more than two months after construction ended at the facility in August.

canada.title: Toronto woman receives $40,000 bill from city after being injured by getaway driver
canada.summary: A Toronto woman who was left with a serious neck injury after her vehicle was struck by the driver of a getaway car following a jewelry store robbery is speaking out about a $40,000 bill she received from the city nearly two years later.

canada.title: Permanent daylight time could cause technical issues for some Manitoba businesses
canada.summary: Manitoba clocks won't be falling back this weekend, but the permanent change to daylight time might cause some confusion for Manitoba business owners.

canada.title: How drones and DNA testing are being used to hunt down invasive wild pigs in Manitoba
canada.summary: Thermal drones and environmental DNA testing are showing promise in strengthening Manitoba's fight against invasive, destructive and disease-carrying wild pigs.

canada.title: Quebec farmers say proposed high-speed rail threatens their land, livelihoods
canada.summary: Farmers east of Montreal are pushing back against a proposed Toronto-Quebec City high-speed rail route they fear could divide their land.

canada.title: Ex-Moncton engineer offers $4M insurance payout in lawsuits over alleged flawed building designs
canada.summary: The next steps in a series of lawsuits alleging flawed building designs by a former Moncton structural engineer began to take shape this week in court over the money to cover the claims.

canada.title: Potato price-fixing lawsuit alleging N.B. giants are part of 'good ol' boys network' goes ahead
canada.summary: A lawsuit against major producers of frozen potato products, including two industry giants from New Brunswick, can go ahead, a U.S. judge has ruled.

canada.title: How Nova Scotia has revived its ‘crime shouldn’t pay’ law
canada.summary: A two-decade-old law the Nova Scotia government overhauled last year with little fanfare is now being deployed to seek the forfeiture of tens of thousands of dollars in suspected proceeds of crime and vehicles ranging from an Audi to Ford F-150 pickups.

canada.title: Infrared was relatively new when this N.L. church was built. Now, it heats it
canada.summary: Holy Cross Anglican Church has been a pillar of the Eastport Peninsula for more than 130 years, and can now stay open year round thanks to a new kind of heating system for the space.

canada.title: Aging water infrastructure is stalling housing construction throughout Quebec
canada.summary: Most of Quebec's water and sewer infrastructure was built between 1950 and 1990, and now much of it is reaching the end of its lifespan. Treatment plants across the province are barely limping along, while sewer pipes are reaching their half-life limit.

canada.title: B.C. man sentenced for 2023 Islamic State knife attack on B.C. bus
canada.summary: Abdul Aziz Kawam was convicted in 2025 and sentenced to 15 years for attempted murder, as well as 20 months for aggravated assault. He will serve 16 years and 8 months in prison.
